scripts.build:cpanel: rm -rf .next out pjbumi-tech-cpanel.zip && CPANEL=true next build && node scripts/fix-cpanel-export.mjs && cd out && zip -r -q ../pjbumi-tech-cpanel.zip . -x 'images.zip' -x '__next*' -x '*.txt'
scripts.build:pages:domain: GITHUB_PAGES=true GITHUB_PAGES_CUSTOM_DOMAIN=true next build && node scripts/fix-github-pages-export.mjs
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && npx gh-pages@6 -d out -t -m "Deploy to GitHub Pages"
scripts.deploy:pages:domain: npm run build:pages:domain && npx gh-pages@6 -d out -t -m "Deploy to custom domain on GitHub Pages"
scripts.deploy:jekyll:pages: npm run build:jekyll:pages && npx gh-pages@6 -d jekyll/_site -t -m "Deploy Jekyll site to GitHub Pages"
scripts.deploy:jekyll:domain: npm run build:jekyll:domain && npx gh-pages@6 -d jekyll/_site -t -m "Deploy Jekyll site to custom domain"
